puzzles.p: A beach town refuses to cancel summer because of one extremely persistent fish.
A young royal runs away from his family business and spends years eating bugs with friends.
Two people fall in love on a very expensive boat trip that goes extremely downhill.
A rich man opens a theme park where the main attractions want to eat the guests.
A teenager borrows a friend's car and accidentally makes his own mom fancy him.
An office worker takes the wrong pill and finds out his job was never real anyway.
An overprotective dad swims across an ocean because his son touched a boat.
Three scientists lose their university jobs and start a pest control company for the dead.
A girl kills someone on arrival in a new country, then teams up with strangers to kill her sister.
A cowboy gets jealous of the new kid at work who thinks he can fly.
A farm boy joins a space wizard and a smuggler to rescue a princess who rescues herself.
A queen with a cold personality locks herself away; her sister gets engaged to a man she met that day.
A grumpy hermit goes on a quest purely to get people out of his garden.
A family business struggles with succession planning and some very unusual negotiation tactics.
An old man refuses to sell his house, so he ties balloons to it and takes a kid along by accident.
A man keeps accidentally turning up at important moments in history and then goes for a very long run.
A boy hides an illegal immigrant in his closet and feeds him candy.

puzzles.t: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
puzzles.p: A boy who lives under the stairs finds out he's famous and goes to a boarding school with a lot of staircases.
alt: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

puzzles.t: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
puzzles.p: A man really wants his boat back.
alt: The Curse of the Black Pearl

puzzles.p: A very confident pilot goes to school, plays volleyball and argues with his classmates.
A man drinks raw eggs, punches meat, runs up some steps and loses.
A very tall man learns he's adopted and visits his real dad at work.
A man goes to his wife's office Christmas party and it gets out of hand.
A boy who doubts things gets on a train that turns up outside his house in the middle of the night.
A neighbor who hates noise breaks into every house in town.
alt: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas

puzzles.p: A man has a terrible Christmas Eve until a trainee angel shows him what his town would look like without him.
A boy asks everyone for one present, and every adult warns him about his eyesight.
Lots of people in London fall in love at Christmas, including a world leader who dances to the Pointer Sisters.
A skeleton gets bored of his job and tries to do someone else's instead.
A boy gets a pet that comes with three simple rules, and nobody follows them.
A dad tries very hard to have a perfect family Christmas and is waiting on his bonus.
A mall employee is taken to court for claiming to be who he says he is.
A man puts on a coat he found and now has a new job he never applied for.
A lazy postman is sent to the worst town in the world and invents a delivery scheme to hit his targets.
A rich man who doesn't like puppets is visited by three ghosts while surrounded by puppets.
A dad leaves his Christmas shopping until Christmas Eve and fights everyone in town for one toy.
A TV boss who hates Christmas gets three ghostly visits during a live broadcast.
Two women swap houses for Christmas, and the houses come with men.
Two entertainers try to save a ski hotel that has no snow by putting on a show.
The family business misses one delivery, so the youngest son sets off to fix it himself.

puzzles.t: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
puzzles.p: A boy takes the wrong flight and checks into a luxury hotel using his dad's card.
An unfinished man moves to the suburbs and becomes the town's most popular hairdresser.
A mall Santa has a second job that's even less festive.
A boy tears up his letter to Santa, and someone else gets the message.
A man's little brother is very famous, very busy and very good at Christmas.
A family goes on vacation and leaves their child in charge of home security.
A teacher skips work to take something out of a museum display, then takes it back to a museum.
alt: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark

puzzles.p: A man travels back in time to visit a woman, and he's very persistent about it.
A space crew picks up a hitchhiker, and only the cat makes it through without a scratch.
A woman stops at a small family business with terrible online reviews.
A writer takes a quiet winter job to finish his book and makes very little progress.
Some men discuss burgers and deliver a briefcase, and the story is told in the wrong order.
A rich man dressed as an animal argues with a clown about how to run a city.
A team breaks into someone's head to plant an idea, then falls asleep several times on the job.
A general loses his job, his family and his farm, then becomes a performer.
A trainee asks a therapist for help with a case. The therapist has dietary issues.
A girl who grew up in Africa struggles more with an American high school.
A teenager skips school and borrows his friend's dad's very expensive car.
Five students spend Saturday in detention and write one essay between them.
Two summer sweethearts change their personalities to impress each other at school.
A teenager on a family vacation learns a dance routine and refuses to sit in the corner.
A man is killed and has to ask a fake psychic to pass messages to his girlfriend.
A businessman hires someone for a week and it goes better than expected for both of them.
A grandfather reads his sick grandson a book with only a few kissing parts.
A woman who loves books moves in with a hairy man with anger issues and a talking candle.
A thief rubs an old lamp and suddenly has a very talkative roommate.
A teenager gives up her voice for a pair of legs to impress a boy she's never spoken to.
A girl sails off to return a stone, accompanied by a demigod and a very confused chicken.
A boy who isn't allowed to play music visits his dead relatives to get permission.
A girl moves house, and the staff inside her head have a very bad week.
A kitchen with a rodent problem gets great reviews.
A dad with a boring office job secretly gets back into his old line of work.
A power company that scares children for energy has a workplace safety incident.
A cleaner who's been working alone for 700 years falls for a new colleague.
A girl's parents eat food that isn't theirs, so she takes a job at a bathhouse to sort it out.
Two sisters move to the countryside and wait at a bus stop with a large furry neighbor.
A group of coworkers who don't get along have to save New York, then go out for shawarma.
A weapons seller builds a better suit in a cave and announces his secret job to the press.
A student gets bitten on a school trip and becomes very good at photographing himself.
A new king has a family argument about the country's foreign policy.

puzzles.t: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
puzzles.p: A small man is asked to return some jewelry, which turns out to be a very long walk.
Some people drive a truck one way through the desert, then drive it back.
A doll has an existential crisis about her feet and visits Los Angeles.
A physicist has a very important meeting in the desert and lots of difficult interviews afterwards.
A man borrows a tall blue body for work and ends up switching sides.
A farmer leaves his crops for a work trip that takes a lot longer than he told his kids.
A man meets his girlfriend's family for the first time, and the weekend is very uncomfortable.
A family all get jobs with the same rich family and don't mention they're related.
A jazz pianist and an actress keep bumping into each other in Los Angeles traffic.
An insurance salesman slowly realizes his neighbors are very good at product placement.
A weatherman keeps waking up to the same song on the radio.
Two kids find an old board game and the house gets an unexpected jungle makeover.
A divorced dad gets a job as his own children's housekeeper.
A child psychologist takes on one patient who can see things nobody else can.
A police officer joins an agency with a very strict dress code that handles immigration from far away.
Unwanted visitors arrive in early July and someone has to give a very loud speech.
A divorcing couple spend a day driving towards the worst weather they can find.
A bus can't slow down, so a police officer and a passenger take over the driving.
A teenage boy lights a candle on Halloween and brings back three very old sisters.
A candy maker invites five children on a factory tour with an unusual safety record.
alt: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

puzzles.p: A nanny arrives by umbrella and adds a lot of sugar to the medicine.
A trainee nun becomes a nanny and teaches seven children to sing in matching outfits.
A bar owner's ex walks into his bar with her new husband, of all the bars in all the world.
A film studio switches to talking pictures and discovers its star has a terrible voice.
A boy asks for martial arts lessons and is given a lot of chores.
A group of kids try to save their houses with an old treasure map and a lot of shouting.
Four friends walk along a railroad track for a weekend, and one of them falls in a pond.
A new teacher tells his students to rip pages out of their textbooks and stand on the furniture.
A university cleaner keeps doing the math homework on the corridor board.
A man with insomnia joins a lot of support groups, then starts a soap business.
Two detectives investigate a series of crimes in a city where it never stops raining.
A woman wakes up from a long nap with a to-do list.
A famous racer gets stuck in a small town after damaging the road and has to fix it.
A villain adopts three girls as part of a plan to steal the Moon.
A new police officer teams up with a con artist to find missing mammals.
A girl is the only one in her family without a superpower, and the house is cracking.
A girl with very long hair finally leaves home to see some lanterns, armed with a frying pan.
